ala.text: Eliza waits outside the necropolis of Unx as one of the few living humans left on Grixis, determined to stay alive, and takes the necropolis by luring its demonic master away with a false tip about a human hermitage.
A rival army led by the lich king Sedris masses on the opposite side, and Eliza sends him her necklace as a ploy to get him face to face, then prepares her armies for war.

When Sedris demands that her minions serve him, Eliza refuses and flings her sword into the necropolis wall, and her necromancy spell bursts the wall to reveal a mile-long skeleton that becomes a skeletal fire-dragon.
She threatens to burn Unx and his armies, and Sedris withdraws his troops from Unx.
